description: Test suite for the Agent class in a TypeScript project, verifying registration of reasoners/skills, router inclusion, local call handling, and memory event filtering.

classes.name: Agent
classes.description: Represents an intelligent agent capable of managing reasoners and skills, including routing and memory event handling.

classes.name: AgentRouter
classes.description: Defines routing logic to organize reasoners and skills with prefixes to simulate different modules or contexts.

methods.name: agent.reasoner
methods.description: Registers a new reasoning function with a specified name.

methods.name: agent.skill
methods.description: Registers a new skill with a specified name.

methods.name: agent.includeRouter
methods.description: Includes a router, integrating its reasoners and skills with prefixes.

methods.name: agent.call
methods.description: Invokes a method or reasoner on the local agent or remotely if configured.

methods.name: agent.watchMemory
methods.description: Sets up a watcher for memory events matching a pattern, with filtering based on scope.

methods.name: dispatchMemoryEvent
methods.description: Internal method to dispatch memory events to registered watchers.

ctags.name: agent
ctags.pattern: /^    const agent = new Agent({ nodeId: 'local', devMode: true });$/

ctags.name: agent
ctags.pattern: /^    const agent = new Agent({ nodeId: 'test-agent', devMode: true });$/

ctags.name: agent
ctags.pattern: /^    const agent = new Agent({ nodeId: 'watcher', devMode: true });$/
